_source: Names and one-line descriptions from the bbchallenge wiki, refreshed from a full export of 17 November 2026 (519 pages; the first version read /wiki/Cryptids and /wiki/BB(6) on 8 November 2026). Each entry is [name, description, {page, categories, edited, credit}]: 'page' is the machine's wiki page (null if the wiki only mentions it on 'mentioned_on'), 'credit' says where the work was first reported: Discord (the bbchallenge server), Marco Dos Santos's Gemini paper (arXiv 2610.22603), or only the wiki itself. Heuristic labels of the community, not results of this repository.
